output.reason: The linked PR [ev-08d80aefd13a] says what the one-line changelog entry [ev-a344853c8f30] leaves out. Usage trackers are a new hook that receives the added or discarded bytes of each stream, together with the stream's labels. They sit alongside the existing `distributor_bytes_received_total` and `discarded_bytes_total` metrics, so operators can build their own per-stream breakdowns, such as bytes by region. The changed files [ev-875659642d81] add a code-level extension point (pkg/loghttp/push/usage_tracker.go, wired up in pkg/loki/loki.go and modules.go) and no config reference docs. This supports typing it as a new, optional extension interface with no change to default behaviour, exposure only for anyone who plugs in a custom tracker, and no consequence for operators who do nothing. Confidence is low because the PR description is cut off at "build a custom…" [ev-08d80aefd13a, ev-1bc8a703cfcd], so a user-facing config option can't be fully ruled out.
